text:
nina: quick heads-up — signing failed in the runtime harden rollout. cosign logs show AccessDenied for kms:Sign from a subset of ephemeral builders. planning a 19:30 PT hotpatch window to fix RBAC or use an ephemeral key. who can own the change?
ryan: I can jump in. error was 'AccessDenied: Caller not authorized for kms:Sign' in cosign output. likely trust condition mismatch.
deepak: CI assumes role build-runner@ci-prod. the trust policy allows tag group builders-prod but not builders-ephemeral. quick fix: add builders-ephemeral to assume-role trust and tighten with sourceVpc condition.
sec-bot: Any RBAC change must be tracked in SEC-9001. CloudTrail will capture policy edits.
nina: I'll open SEC-9001 with justification "hotpatch: restore signing for ephemeral builders" and an automatic revert in 12h.
ryan: alternative (safer): create ephemeral asymmetric KMS key for the window, grant kms:Sign+kms:GetPublicKey to ephemeral role, then disable after. less risky for main key.
deepak: if we take ephemeral-key route, upload the public key to s3://redwood-provenance/keys/ and annotate image manifest with x-sign-key so verification is auditable.
nina: ops checklist for 19:30PT window: 1) create ephemeral key (ECDSA_P256), 2) grant Sign/GetPublicKey to role/ephemeral-builder only, 3) set key tag ttl=12h + ephemeral:true, 4) update CI COSIGN_KEY_URI env, 5) run build+sign smoke, 6) cosign verify, 7) upload pubkey and attestations, 8) disable key and revert any policy changes.
ryan: I'll create the key and update CI env. will push verification snippet to ci-templates: `for img in $IMAGES; do cosign verify --key $COSIGN_KEY_URI $img || exit 1; done`
deepak: I'll tail cosign logs and validate signature bundle includes expected key id. abort if mismatch. also patch Dockerfile to pin libcrypto to patched version — CVE-2026-1101 still showing in scans.
nina: PR owner for Dockerfile is security/sprint-112. block release until scan passes.
sec-bot: Automated scan queued for base-minimal:2026-03-24-hotfix.
oncall: oncall here — standby. if verify fails open #release-war-room and mark rollback. runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ops/pages/IMG-HOTPATCH-RB (linked).
ryan: done creating ephemeral key and updated CI env var. kicking a smoke-build now. :construction:
deepak: cosign sign completed, signature shows keyId=key-ephemeral-6043210000. running `cosign verify` now.
nina: quick audit step after sign: query CloudTrail where eventName=Sign and keyId contains key-ephemeral-6043210000, capture last 10 events and attach to SEC-9001.
sec-bot: Reminder: tag ephemeral keys with 'ephemeral:true' and include TTL in KMS tags. Also annotate the image manifest with `provenance.attestations` pointing to attestation UUIDs.
ryan: verify passed for all images. pushing CI hotfix to ensure cosign verify is in template.
deepak: vulnerability scan still running, but Dockerfile pin PR created.
nina: excellent. we'll close SEC-9001 after 12h revert check. if we used ephemeral key escape hatch, 72h postmortem required. thanks team. keep messages short while we monitor.
